description: AmbientOS policies for Jarvis (Layer 1) — same Cedar-mirroring schema as context-fabric policies.json (principal/action/resource/condition, Permit vs Forbid, Forbid overrides, default DENY). Evaluated by context-fabric's PolicyEvaluator; Jarvis does not evaluate policies itself.

policies.description: Owner who is present can do everything.
Guest may read safe, non-personal information.
Guest cannot control the system (volume, screen, media, apps).
Guest cannot write or delete notes, reminders, memory or files.
Guest cannot execute routines, research jobs or code fixes.
Unidentified actor may only read weather and time.
Unidentified actor can do nothing else.
Nobody controls the system while AWAY and absent (overrides permits).
